why_local.text: Prompts, documents and answers never leave this computer. That is a simpler guarantee than any contract a provider can offer.
No rate limits, no outages caused by someone else's demand, no surprise deprecations. A validated, pinned model behaves the same next month.
You control the whole chain: the model, its exact version, the serving software and who can reach it. No outside service joins your attack surface.

blockers.guidance: Follow the two-week pilot plan on the hardware you already have.

pilot_plan: Days 1-2: run the advisor, install only the recommended runtime and model, confirm outbound traffic is blocked (make egress-test).
Days 3-4: write 20-30 real questions your team asks (the golden set) and record today's answers and time spent.
Days 5-7: daily use by one or two people; log what worked and what did not.
Days 8-10: if documents matter, ingest one folder and test search with citations against the golden set.
Days 11-12: review the audit log, memory use and speed against the estimates here.
Days 13-14: decide go / adjust / stop, using the golden-set results and the cost comparison.

privacy.egress: Deny all outbound by default. Model downloads happen only in a separate `make pull` step. SearXNG may reach search engines (named exception).
privacy.encryption_at_rest: Full-disk encryption required (FileVault / LUKS / BitLocker); encrypted backups.
privacy.remote_access: None by default; if needed, WireGuard/Tailscale only. Never port-forward.

warnings: Offline operation is required: web research works only while a connection is available.
Assumption: Occasional code questions handled by general model.
Exact chip/GPU not given; speed assumes a conservative apple_m2.

estimates_note: All memory, speed, disk and price figures are estimates, not benchmarks.

api_open.label: Hosted open-weight model API (e.g. Qwen3.6 35B-A3B via a router)

subscription.label: Flat-rate AI subscription (team plan, per user)

tco.verdict: On these estimates, a hosted open-weight model API would be cheaper than local by about $83 over three years. Local is recommended here for privacy, availability, security, not price.
assumptions: admin time at $0/hour (your own time is not priced); electricity $0.17/kWh
High-memory machines may hold resale value while memory prices are high; resale is not counted.
